markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 surgical frozen section with consensus invasive call [F1] and tumor flagged at all four margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0% (ECE 5%, n=132) | Near-certain score; small calibration set |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% coverage (alpha=0.10, n=132) | Single class; dataset-level guarantee only |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 24th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical input; error AUROC 0.70 |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (similarity 0.89–0.93) [F5]; InSitu contrast 0.83 | Unanimous neighbors; InSitu contrast nearby |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 8, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.62 contribution; 19/20 AI spot-check), separates from InSitu BACH_0165 [F2] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 7, 9) · context · Above-typical score (-1.56 contribution); descriptive only with 8/20 AI spot-check [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 2, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.85 contribution), failed 0/20 AI spot-check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.66; +0.74 contribution), separates from InSitu BACH_0165 (20/20 spot-check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing 3 top-risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (+0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064). Case leans on Unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 stain degradation on this simulated frozen section mimics stromal invasion vs InSitu contrast case BACH_0165 (similarity 0.83).
- Dense TILs (regions 4, 7, 9) obscure duct boundaries while myoepithelial stains and cell segmentation are unavailable.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 8, 9**: Verify true stromal invasion vs in situ carcinoma without myoepithelial stains.
2. **Regions 1, 2, 10**: Inspect nuclear pleomorphism (region 2) and confirm mitoses directly; mitotic concept is Unreliable.
3. **Regions 0–3, 4, 7, 8–11**: Check superior/inferior (860 um) and medial/lateral (645 um) margins amidst TILs.
